backgroundRemover.packagingRule: The release lock and runtime manifest must repeat the exact patch id/path/SHA-256 set below, plus the bundled Python and PyTorch versions and the tool used to create a relocatable worker for the release target architecture. A copied virtualenv entry script is not a self-contained worker.

ffmpeg.provenanceRule: Every release lock must name the FFmpeg version, an immutable binary source matching the release target architecture, and its SHA-256. Mutable latest/download URLs are not accepted as reproducible provenance.
ffmpeg.licenseRule: The license pack must contain the license and configure/build provenance for the exact FFmpeg binary. Builds containing --enable-nonfree are rejected because they cannot be redistributed. Whether an otherwise redistributable build is LGPL or GPL depends on its enabled libraries.
